name: Gated Residual
tagline: Residual block with a single learnable scalar gate alpha (init=1.0) on the residual branch.
diff_from_baseline: Inspired by learnable residual scaling (cf. ReZero, transformer resid-lambdas). Unlike ReZero (init=0), starts from standard residual behavior with α=1.0 and lets training adjust the gate.

name: Pre-Activation
tagline: He et al. 2016 v2: BN-ReLU-Conv ordering with residual scaling for cleaner gradient flow through identity shortcuts.
diff_from_baseline: He et al. 2016 (ECCV) — "Identity Mappings in Deep Residual Networks". Pre-activation ordering yields cleaner gradient flow through identity shortcuts, beneficial for very deep networks.

name: Stochastic Depth
tagline: Randomly drop the residual branch per block during training with linearly-decaying survival probability.
pseudocode:
1. Index each residual block $i \in \{1,...,L\}$.
2. Survival prob $p_i = 1 - \frac{i}{L}(1 - p_L)$, where $p_L = 0.5$.
3. Compute $F(x) = \mathrm{BN}_2(W_2\mathrm{ReLU}(\mathrm{BN}_1(W_1 x)))$.
4. If training: with prob $p_i$ output $\mathrm{ReLU}(F(x) + \mathrm{shortcut}(x))$, else output $\mathrm{ReLU}(\mathrm{shortcut}(x))$.
5. If eval: output $\mathrm{ReLU}(p_i \cdot F(x) + \mathrm{shortcut}(x))$.
diff_from_baseline: Huang et al. 2016 (ECCV) — "Deep Networks with Stochastic Depth". Implicit ensembling regularizer; shortens expected depth at training time and is a standard recipe for very deep ResNets (110+).
